root_exact_check.ordinary_proof: Root re-derived Theorem A: J, K <= t+1; J + K <= t+2; under no b-path the greedy span s-K(s), s, g(s), ..., g^{b-2}(s) is >= N and <= (t+2) + (b-3)(t+1) = N, which forces J(x + J(x)) = t+1; the orbit from u = g(0) reaches u-1 after b-2 steps of t+1, so J(u-1) = t+1 >= 2 contradicts K(u) = 1. The application to S_a with t = a-2 is correct. The lower bound is the source's Theorem 4.5 block colouring.
